# Roster scoring matrix

Constraint-first editorial decision: cover all 12 branches; retain both Healing, both Rage and both Toxin candidates; retain distinct caster/defender/duelist/striker/DoT/execute roles; then reduce duplicate weapons and silhouettes with small rig families. Scores support this decision, not a measured quality or balance ranking.

0 absent/unverified, 1 weak/high cost, 2 limited, 3 adequate, 4 strong, 5 distinctive/low cost. All columns higher is favorable. Ordinal editorial estimates, not measured runtime evidence.

All weights are 1. Rights are 0 for everyone and cannot be offset by a high total. The total is an ordinal comparison, not a production-readiness gate.

## Decision rationale

Brumgar and Elunor both stay despite their duplicate unordered Guardian/Healing pair: only two sourced Healing candidates exist, and brawler versus ritual healer is a useful distinction. The same coverage constraint retains both Toxin candidates despite Sylvex/Skarvex extension costs. Oromir is mandatory for Ice. Four reserves primarily reduce redundant melee pressure, heavy fists/hammer and Precision/Dodge blades. Unknown rights do not favor the best-looking picture: even Solkael remains blocked at production entry.
